snippet.title: Once Upon A KATAMARI - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Let the good times ROLL on 24 October, 2025! Time travel across eras and restore the stars in Once Upon A KATAMARI 🌈

Experience a fabulous new soundtrack, cousin customization, and 4 player KatamariBall mode!

This will be a #Katamari experience for the ages! #OnceUponAKATAMARI
